question: Should the current-main port land the broader PDF extraction-limit config semantics together with the stack-safe parser and stale queue cleanup, or should the PR be narrowed to the remaining parser/session cleanup for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90098?
rationale: The code direction is mostly right, but the branch is now conflicting and includes compatibility-sensitive config/default and persisted queue behavior that automation should not silently choose while porting across the UI relocation and merged parser hardening.

options.title: Port and narrow to the tracker
options.body: Rebase onto current main, keep the stack-safe gateway/UI parser and stale queue cleanup, and drop or separately review any PDF config semantic expansion not required for the canonical tracker.

options.title: Port the whole broader fix
options.body: Keep the PDF extraction-limit semantics in the rebase if maintainers explicitly accept the config/default and host-cost behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but do not repair it until a maintainer decides whether the older branch is still the preferred landing vehicle after the UI relocation and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99213 merge.

recommendation.title: Port and narrow to the tracker
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, keep the stack-safe gateway/UI parser and stale queue cleanup, and drop or separately review any PDF config semantic expansion not required for the canonical tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest prior maintainer review context for the canonical fix boundary and duplicate consolidation.
